args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion, from Sofia Marchetti:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb. Use "Pellow Home Living" for PHL going forward.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That report needs its label updated to match the rename.
- Please check whether any other saved reports, digests or account records still use "Covey & Lark" or "Covey".
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Bettina Kroll

args.text:
